text:
Before consulting, please inquire about the costs carefully. We inquired about orthodontic consultations on their page, asking if there was a charge. They replied that consultations were free, and they also offered dental implant consultations. However, they didn't mention a sterilization fee. So we decided to go for a consultation. Upon arrival, they took us for an X-ray. We asked if there was a charge, and the counter staff said no, it was included in the package. We hadn't agreed to anything yet and asked to think about it. Then a bill came with 500 + 200 baht. We offered to pay only the 200 baht sterilization fee, which led to a long argument.
The sterilization fee here is expensive.
Also, the counter staff and employees shouldn't have asked, "Are you sure you want to proceed?" It's a very inappropriate question.

Further clarification:
The statement that the staff clearly and completely informed us of the details is untrue.

- The Facebook page said consultations were free, but they didn't mention the 200 baht sterilization fee. Even when we arrived, there was a sign advertising the 200 baht sterilization fee, but the staff still hadn't informed us. If they had informed us completely from the beginning, we could have decided whether or not to come for the consultation, saving us time.

- The counter staff didn't ask about the X-ray before it was done. Shouldn't the clinic always ask the client about the costs before proceeding? They didn't ask or inform me that there would be a 500 baht charge if I didn't decide to proceed. Why would I refuse the charge later if that's the case?
If they had detailed the costs from the beginning, I wouldn't have done it, because I already had the X-ray films.
I think the clinic didn't mention that I already had the films because they needed to keep the information on file, like other places that offer free X-rays.

I understand that clinics have different conditions and everything has a cost, but the price should have been disclosed before the procedure.
